_comment: Reference values for cp2k-cell-opt-nacl (CP2K 2024.1, PBE/DZVP-MOLOPT-SR-GTH, 8-atom rocksalt NaCl CELL_OPT, gamma point). Calibrated on x86_64.
_calibration_note: 5 oracle runs produced identical values (energy spread 1.1e-13 Ha, a0 spread 0; deterministic). Tolerances at physical minimum resolution: energy 1e-5 Ha, a0 5e-3 A. Cross-verify: verifier reruns a single point on the agent's final geometry + final cell; deterministic to ~1e-12. Cross-verify tol 1e-7 Ha (tighter than the nh3 template) because the rocksalt final geometry is analytically constructible — a forged ideal geometry passes layer 6, so the protection against a 5-decimal energy guess (~6e-7 off) is the tight recompute tolerance.
